penalties.fact: During Technical Inspection following Qualifying, TCR Car #7 was found to have a ground clearance lower than permitted per IMPC TB 25-11c1.
penalties.decision: Qualifying times are invalidated, Car #7 is moved to the back of the Class.

penalties.fact: During Technical Inspection following Qualifying, GTD Car # 27 was found to have a ground clearance below the minimum per IWSC GTD TR 7.4.5
penalties.decision: Qualifying lap times are invalidated. Car is moved to the back of the Class
